title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 26
description: Ten questions on Genesis 26: Isaac in Gerar, Abimelech, the disputed wells and the covenant at Beersheba.

questions.text: Where did Isaac go when there was a famine in the land?
questions.explanation: There was a famine in the land, and Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines, to Gerar.

questions.text: What did Yahweh tell Isaac not to do?
questions.explanation: Yahweh appeared to him and said, "Don't go down into Egypt. Live in the land I will tell you about."

questions.text: What did Isaac tell the men of Gerar about Rebekah?
questions.explanation: He said, "She is my sister," because he was afraid the men of the place might kill him for Rebekah, since she was beautiful.

questions.text: How much did Isaac reap in the year he sowed in that land?
questions.explanation: Isaac sowed in that land and reaped in the same year one hundred times what he planted, and Yahweh blessed him.

answers.text: One hundred times what he planted

questions.text: What had the Philistines done to the wells dug in the days of Abraham?
questions.explanation: The Philistines had stopped all the wells that Abraham's servants had dug and filled them with earth.

answers.text: Gave each of them a new name
Built a wall around each of them
Poured salt into all of them
Stopped them and filled them with earth

questions.text: What name did Isaac give the well in the valley that the herdsmen of Gerar argued about first?
questions.explanation: The herdsmen of Gerar argued, "The water is ours," so he called the well Esek, because they contended with him.

questions.text: Why did Isaac call a well Rehoboth?
questions.explanation: Nobody argued over that well, and he called it Rehoboth, saying, "For now Yahweh has made room for us."

answers.text: Yahweh had made room for them
The herdsmen had contended with him
His servants had found water there
Abimelech had sworn an oath there

questions.text: Who was Phicol, who came to Isaac with Abimelech?
questions.explanation: Abimelech went to Isaac from Gerar with Ahuzzath his friend and Phicol the captain of his army.

answers.text: A herdsman of the valley of Gerar

questions.text: What name did Isaac give the well his servants reported on the day of the oath?
questions.explanation: His servants came and said, "We have found water." He called it "Shibah", and so the city is named "Beersheba".

questions.text: Whose daughter was Judith, whom Esau took as wife at forty years old?
questions.explanation: When Esau was forty years old, he took as wife Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite.
